name: Alameda County Community Food Bank
description: The Alameda County Community Food Bank is one of the largest food banks in the nation, distributing millions of pounds of food annually through a network of partner agencies and direct distribution programs.
fullDescription: The Alameda County Community Food Bank is one of the largest food banks in the nation, distributing millions of pounds of food annually through a network of partner agencies and direct distribution programs.
whatTheyOffer:
- Free groceries and hot meals through 350+ partner food pantries, hot-meal programs, and senior centers
- Emergency Food Helpline that connects callers to food the same day, in multiple languages
- Fresh fruit, vegetables, milk, eggs, bread, and staples
- Free summer meals for children under 18
- CalFresh (food stamps) application assistance
howToGetIt: Call the Emergency Food Helpline at 510-635-3663 (Monday-Friday, 9 a.m.-4 p.m.) or visit FoodNow.net to find a food pantry or hot meal near you. If you leave a message, staff will call back the same day. Each partner site sets its own hours and guidelines.
keywords: Alameda County Community Food Bank, free food, food pantry, groceries, CalFresh, food stamps, produce, mobile pantry, food distribution
